item.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
item.description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

item.title: Republicans kick off unconventional midterm convention in Dallas with Trump speech
item.description: Republicans' first midterm convention, being touted as a "Trumpapalooza" by the Republican Party chairman, kicks off in Dallas with a program focused heavily on tax cuts and border security.

item.title: Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight
item.description: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.

item.title: Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps
item.description: A Trump census proposal would stop asking about race and exclude millions of U.S. residents from a count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."

item.title: National Guard member arrested after drawing gun on fellow soldier in D.C.
item.description: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.

item.title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
item.description: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

item.title: Ballot seizures seemed impossible. But judges and officials are prepping for them now
item.description: The idea of law enforcement taking possession of ballots in the middle of an active election used to be considered impossible. Now, it's a scenario voting officials — and judges — are training for.

item.title: Trump promises $5,000 dividend in convention speech, but only if Republicans win
item.description: Calling it a "Trump dividend," the president announced a $5,000 payment for every adult citizen if the Republican Party maintains control of the House and Senate in the midterm election.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
item.description: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

item.title: Republicans hope unconventional convention will rally voters ahead of midterms
item.description: The Republican party is calling it a "Trumpapalooza." The party is throwing an unconventional convention in Dallas this week to try to boost Republican voter enthusiasm.
